title: Trade-In Agreements Payoff Shortfall: Calculation of the Customer Payment
content:
**Statement of calculation.** On a **Trade-In Agreements** agreement, the shortfall payment is the latest recorded payoff quote amount plus the quote's per diem for each calendar day after its good-through date through the day of payment, less the agreement's undistributed trade equity, never less than none, rounded to the nearest cent.

## Inputs

| Input | Read from |
|---|---|
| Latest recorded payoff quote amount | The most recent payoff quote entry on the agreement's history, by quote date |
| Per diem | The per diem amount on that quote |
| Good-through date | The good-through date on that quote; per diem runs for each calendar day after it through the day of payment, and for no day when payment falls on or before it |
| Undistributed trade equity | The agreement's equity balance on the day of payment |

## Worked examples (hypothetical figures)

Latest quote $16500.00, per diem $2.75, good through the 12th; undistributed trade equity $14000.00.

| Day of payment | Per diem days | Payoff with per diem | Shortfall payment |
|---|---|---|---|
| The 11th | 0 | $16500.00 | $2500.00 |
| The 12th | 0 | $16500.00 | $2500.00 |
| The 15th | 3 | $16508.25 | $2508.25 |

With undistributed trade equity of $17000.00 the payoff figure is covered and the shortfall payment is $0.00.
